name: ma-commander
description: Securely inspect and manage an authorized remote computer through MA Commander.

interface.longDescription: MA Commander lets users securely inspect and manage an authorized remote computer through MCP. It supports files, processes, developer commands, persistent sessions, WSL workspaces, resumable transfers, screenshots, policy-gated GUI control, and limited privileged operations. Access is restricted by MA Commander safety policy and the permissions granted during authorization.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my authorized computer is online.
Show system information for my connected computer.
List files in a folder on my authorized computer.
